name: First Citizens BancShares, Inc.
moat_justification: Weak-to-moderate moat: a genuinely differentiated innovation/fund banking franchise inherited from SVB and a disciplined, family-led relationship-banking culture with a proven record of discount-priced acquisitions (CIT, SVB, BMO branches), against commodity banking products with low switching costs, rate-hostage NIM, a flight-proven venture-concentrated deposit base, fading SVB purchase-accounting accretion, and no structural cost advantage.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 5.8%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 16.2x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Quality regional bank with a real innovation-banking niche, moat 4/10 — but at $2,080.19 it doesn't clear 15% (weighted IRR 10.9%, IV@15% $1,393.43); it clears the hurdle only at or below ~$1,393.
moat_for: SVB innovation/fund banking franchise — sticky venture/tech relationships few regionals can replicate
Conservative family-led underwriting culture; proven opportunistic acquirer at discounts (CIT, SVB, BMO branches)
Large diversified deposit base ($173.43B at Q2 2026) funding loan growth
Capital building (CET1 10.77% at Q2 2026) plus heavy buybacks shrinking share count 5.8%/yr
moat_against: Commodity loans/deposits — price competition, low switching costs outside the innovation niche
Earnings hostage to rates, deposit repricing and the credit cycle (CRE and venture exposures)
SVB deposit base is venture-concentrated and already proved flight-prone under stress
SVB purchase-accounting accretion fades, removing a reported-earnings tailwind
No cost leadership — mid-pack efficiency, integration load from serial deals
